P.title: Orphan
P.gift: Accumulates power through repetition and endurance; reads the field through proximity; knows scarcity as a form of intelligence.
P.shadow: Mistaking stillness for safety; compressing possibility into compliance; surviving the crisis while forgetting what was worth surviving for.

R.title: Warrior
R.gift: Converts open space into structure; holds the line so others can move; makes safety legible to the whole field.
R.shadow: Fortifying what should be released; mistaking the perimeter for the purpose; building walls after the crisis has already entered.

B.title: Magician
B.gift: Moves along the invisible axis; finds the angle that transforms meaning without moving the center; makes pattern legible where others see only noise.
B.shadow: Cleverness that avoids commitment; interpretation weaponized as distance; reframing so fluently that nothing is ever faced directly.

N.title: Wanderer
N.gift: Breaks the predictive model by refusing its geometry; arrives where it was not anticipated; survives by being unreadable to the field.
N.shadow: Restlessness performed as strategy; disruption without destination; becoming so irregular that no collective can hold you.

Q.title: Ruler
Q.gift: Integrates and activates; holds the widest view while remaining capable of precise action; mobilizes the field rather than just reading it.
Q.shadow: Collapsing plurality into a single will; moving so fast the field cannot respond; command that mistakes speed for wisdom.

K.title: Altruist
K.gift: Holds the system past its breaking point; absorbs accumulated risk so the field can persist; knows that to preserve is sometimes the most radical act.
K.shadow: Continuity as inertia; maintaining a brittle order past its usefulness; absorbing so much that nothing is left to transmit forward.
